name: Mizukami (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mizukami village emblem in white: a stylised device of three curved horizontal strokes, like the character 三.
history: Municipal flag of Mizukami, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1969.

features.role: Mizukami village emblem — a stylised device of three curved horizontal strokes, like the character 三
